C-21.Name: Dead-link validation: missing files and unresolvable anchors in the problems panel (matrix P1)
C-21.Summary: Agent documents cross-link sibling files and headings; typos surface only as silently dead links. C-21 extends the C-17 problems panel with a second, async issue family: relative file/image destinations that do not exist on disk and anchor destinations (#slug) that match no heading (github-slug comparison against the document's own headings). Reuses the markdownLint line classifiers (code/front-matter immunity) and muya's generateGithubSlug; surfaced through the same doc-markdown-changed debounce as a doc-deadlinks bus payload the panel merges under the lint issues.

Problem.Description: Markdown links rot: files move, headings get renamed, agents hallucinate paths. Nothing in Mark flags a broken destination.
Problem.RootCause: The C-17 lint rules are pure-text (no filesystem knowledge), and no link-existence check existed upstream (matrix: "Link validation ❌ — P1").
Problem.Evidence: docs/research/markdown-feature-matrix.md Quality & formatting row. Existing machinery: util/markdownLint.js classifiers (front matter + fences + headings), muya/lib/utils/url.js generateGithubSlug, window.fileUtils.stat, the problems panel's issue-list contract and the 500ms doc-markdown-changed debounce in editor.vue.

Goals.R-1: Pure checker module util/linkCheck.js: checkMarkdownLinks(markdown, { statFn, pathname }) → issues [{ rule: 'deadlink-file' | 'deadlink-image' | 'deadlink-anchor', line, excerpt, message }]. Relative destinations only (http/https/mailto/data/#-only/absolute URLs skipped); anchor destinations validated against github-slugs computed from the document's own headings; file destinations resolved against the document's directory (subtree clamp like ASK_FOR_FILE_PATH); fenced-code and front-matter contents immune; per-run stat cache (one stat per unique path).
Goals.R-2: Async surfacing: the same 500ms debounce that emits doc-markdown-changed also runs the checker (only for tabs with a pathname) and emits doc-deadlinks { issues }; the problems panel merges them under the lint issues (sorted by line); preference gate markdownLint covers both families (off clears everything).
Goals.R-3: Untitled tabs (no pathname): only anchor checks run — file checks are skipped, not fabricated.

Constraints.Constraint: No new dependencies; reuses markdownLint classifiers, muya slug util, the problems panel.
Read-only surface: stat only, subtree-clamped to the document directory.
Checker is dependency-injected (statFn) for deterministic unit tests; e2e gates the live path via shim stat mocks.
Scoped 100% coverage of the checker module; e2e visual gate; grace lint zero findings; two sequential reviews.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Remote (http) link liveness checks — offline-first, no network.
Inline squiggle decoration (same follow-up as C-17).
Cross-file heading anchors (file.md#slug) — v1 validates in-document anchors only.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit: dead file/image/anchor detection, URL/anchor-only skips, code+front-matter immunity, subtree clamp, stat cache (one call per unique path), untitled-tab behavior (anchor-only when statFn null).
Component: the panel merges doc-deadlinks under lint issues; markdownLint off clears both families.
E2e: a fixture with a live link, a dead file link, and a dead anchor shows exactly the two dead issues; a live anchor shows none. Full suite green; grace lint zero; two reviews clean.

AffectedAreas.M-011: linkCheck util + editor.vue async emission + problems panel merge
